payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: In the edited image, is there clear evidence that the requested paper has begun entering or is inside the requested cup?
node.criteria: Pass only when the paper and cup are identifiable and visible evidence shows some of the paper entering or inside the cup. Fail only when both objects and their relevant placement are clearly visible and the paper remains outside, with no entry. Unknown if either object or their spatial relation cannot be verified; do not infer progress or absence from a similar-looking object or from the paper being held.
node.binding: Assess only progress on stuffing the source paper into the source cup, using source and edited images. Verify the objects and their spatial relation in the edited image; proximity, contact with the rim, or an unverified object match is not entry.
